mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT mc.unit_cost FROM fin_material_cost mc WHERE mc.material_id = i.material_id AND mc.unit_cost > 0 AND mc.period <= YEAR(u.use_date) * 100 + MONTH(u.use_date) ORDER BY mc.period DESC LIMIT 1), m.ref_cost, 0)

SELECT u.*, d.name AS dept_name, su.nickname AS user_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, a.name AS expense_account_name, sd.doc_no AS wms_doc_no, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) FROM fin_consumable_use_item i WHERE i.use_id = u.id) AS total_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(i.qty * , 2)), 0) FROM fin_consumable_use_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.use_id = u.id) AS ref_amount FROM fin_consumable_use u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = u.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = u.expense_account_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc sd ON sd.id = u.wms_doc_id
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, l.name AS location_name, AS ref_unit_cost FROM fin_consumable_use_item i JOIN fin_consumable_use u ON u.id = i.use_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id WHERE i.use_id = #{useId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO fin_consumable_use_item (use_id, material_id, location_id, batch_no, qty, remark) VALUES
(#{i.useId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.locationId}, #{i.batchNo}, #{i.qty}, #{i.remark})
mapper.select: SELECT t.dept_id AS "deptId", d.name AS "deptName", t.material_id AS "materialId", m.code AS "materialCode", m.name AS "materialName", m.unit AS "unit", t.qty AS "qty", t.ref_amount AS "refAmount" FROM ( SELECT u.dept_id, i.material_id, SUM(i.qty) AS qty, SUM(ROUND(i.qty * , 2)) AS ref_amount FROM fin_consumable_use u JOIN fin_consumable_use_item i ON i.use_id = u.id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE u.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND u.use_date >= #{begin} AND u.use_date <= #{end} AND u.dept_id = #{deptId} GROUP BY u.dept_id, i.material_id ) t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = t.dept_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = t.material_id ORDER BY d.name, m.code

SELECT i.material_id AS "materialId", u.dept_id AS "deptId", u.expense_account_id AS "accountId", SUM(i.qty) AS "qty" FROM fin_consumable_use u JOIN fin_consumable_use_item i ON i.use_id = u.id WHERE u.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND u.use_date >= #{begin} AND u.use_date <= #{end} GROUP BY i.material_id, u.dept_id, u.expense_account_id
